state.objective: Drive trial of the reformulated high-protein Oikos range ahead of the spring reset

approvals.reason: Over 150,000 EUR requires trading director and client sign-off

gate.instructions: Is this media plan deliverable as specified? It is NOT deliverable if the plan asks any inventory-bounded placement for materially more budget than is actually available over the flight, or if any required creative language is missing for a requested surface. Judge deliverability, not whether the plan is a good idea.

lever.instructions: Which single change would best fix this plan before it goes to approval? Read requested_over_available per placement. A value above 1 on an inventory-bounded surface means the plan asks for budget that does not exist, and no amount of bidding will spend it. Choose approve_as_is only when undeliverable_eur is zero and creative_ready is true. Prefer a change inside the agency mandate over escalating. Escalate only when the fix requires changing total budget, the objective or the CPA target, which belong to the advertiser.

criteria.approve_as_is: The plan is deliverable and priced correctly. Send it for approval unchanged
criteria.rebalance_to_offsite: Move the undeliverable onsite allocation to offsite inventory, accepting a higher cost per outcome to keep the budget working
criteria.extend_flight: Lengthen the flight so the same onsite budget has more weeks of inventory to spend against
criteria.add_retailer: Add another retailer network to widen the onsite pool rather than over-allocating one retailer
criteria.reduce_budget: Reduce the total budget to what the requested placements can actually deliver, and return the remainder
criteria.relax_cpa_target: Raise the CPA target so cheaper-to-reach inventory qualifies
criteria.escalate_to_client: The plan cannot be fixed inside the agency mandate because it needs a change to budget, objective or target that belongs to the advertiser

severity.instructions: How much delivery risk does this plan carry as written, judged against its budget and flight?
criteria: On plan. No deviation worth an operator looking at it
Minor drift, within tolerance, likely self correcting
Material drift. Needs attention this week
Serious. The objective is at risk without action today
Critical. Budget is actively being wasted right now
